prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: single production reference for a 128x128 pixel-art side-scrolling RPG enemy. Input image is STYLE ONLY: match the barbarian's crisp dark outlines, carefully grouped pixels, rich but controlled 3-4 tone material shading, readable volumetric anatomy and equal finish. Do not borrow human anatomy, clothing, blond hair or club. Draw ONE isolated full-body enemy facing LEFT in strict lateral profile, fixed side camera. Detailed 128px sprite aesthetic, not smooth painting, not coarse polygons, not photorealism, no dithering or noisy speckles. Light from upper-left. Every limb fully visible within ample padding. Transparent background with real alpha; no checkerboard, ground, cast shadow, scenery, text, labels or frame. Reference standing/resting pose. Preserve subject identity exactly.
Subject: A squat, heavy amphibian. Broad waist-high body, low head sunk in shoulders, massive folded hind thighs, short braced forelegs, four widely planted splayed feet. Thick warty peat-brown and dull-olive skin with mud creases. Pale yellow-gray belly folds and a loose drooping throat sac. Black protruding eyes under heavy lids; each has a SMALL HORIZONTAL WHITE STRIP across black, no iris. Wide downward mouth seam, aggrieved expression, no smile. No equipment.
